block.guhs.guhbioscoop_doek.lore: Build a screen out of it: up to 7 wide and 4 high. The bigger the better, nyeg.
block.guhs.guhbioscoop_popcornmachine.lo: Pop! With one in the theater every guh gets a tub of popcorn with the movie. Right-click: one for you too.
block.guhs.guhbioscoop_projector.lore: Put it down with the lens toward a Cinema Screen. Right-click: pick one of your movies. Rattle rattle!
block.guhs.guhbioscoop_stoeltje.lore: For you and for your guhs: during a movie they hop on by themselves. Lovely plush.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhbioscoop_alles.de: Watch all &dnine movies&r to the end: Skyblok, Bedwars, Chonknite, Guhmon, Farmer Wants a Guh, Among Guhs, Baltoguh, Guhtwo and 626. They all end the same way. Guess how, nyeg.
Buy a &dPopcorn Machine&r from the &dShopkeeper Guh&r and put it in your theater. Every guh that comes to watch gets a tub of popcorn with the movie. Right-click it and you get one too. No crumbs, nyeg. (Crumbs.)
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhbioscoop_eerste_f: Right-click the projector and pick a movie: you get one for every Guhpixel joke game you finish, and for the stories of Baltoguh, Guhtwo and 626-guh too. Watch it to the end. Your guhs find a seat by themselves, and with a &dPopcorn Machine&r they get popcorn. Quiet in the theater, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhbioscoop_projecto: Buy a &dGuh Cinema Set&r from the &dShopkeeper Guh&r in the Guhpixel lobby: a projector, a whole screen of Cinema Screen (7 wide, 4 high) and four Cinema Seats. Build the screen at home and put the projector in front of it, with the lens toward the screen. Rattle rattle!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.dagboek.film: I watched the movie %s! I only fell asleep a little bit.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.dagboek.film_popcor: I watched the movie %s, with popcorn! The popcorn was the most exciting part.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.einde: The end of %s. Wahoog, what a movie!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o1: Aboard The Chonkfarer the crew is working very hard.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o10: Sabotage: zero. Shoved: nobody. Snored: plenty.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o11: Crew wins! Because nobody did anything at all.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o12: Captain Guh: 'Want to try it for real, nyeg?'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o2: Well. Hard. All the tasks are still at zero.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o3: But they do look lovely lying there, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o4: Emergency meeting! Somebody leaned on the button.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o7: The vote: who ate the last nibble?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o8: Everybody has crumbs. All very suspicious.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o9: And the Mika? Asleep in the vent.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.slot: Finish the Among Guhs parody round with Captain Guh in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.uitleg: Aboard The Chonkfarer somebody is the Mika. But who is actually awake?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o1: In Nomguh the baby guhs are sick. Achoo-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o10: The baby guhs are better! Baltoguh is the Hero of Nomguh!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o11: And the hero? Already asleep. It was a long ride.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o2: The medicine is in the mountain hut. Behind the snowstorm.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o3: Steele Mika laughs: 'That wolf guh will never make it!'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o4: Baltoguh says nothing. Baltoguh grabs the sled.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o5: Through the storm! Left! Right! Straight on, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o6: It is cold. It is far. But nibbles are waiting at home.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o7: The mountain hut! And there: the medicine chest!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o8: Back through the night. Baltoguh howls at the northern lights.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o9: The northern lights don't howl back. But they are pretty.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.slot: Become the Hero of Nomguh: finish the story of Baltoguh.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.uitleg: The baby guhs of Nomguh are sick. Only Baltoguh dares to cross the snowstorm.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o1: Four teams, four little islands. And one very important bed.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o10: Five? Yes. The camera guh slept too, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o2: Defend your bed with everything you've got, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o3: The best defense: lie in it yourself.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o5: The enemy is building a bridge. Very. Slowly.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o6: Block by block they come closer...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o7: They're here! They're next to your bed! They...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o8: ...cozily lie down beside you. Good night.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.slot: Finish Bedwars in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.uitleg: Four teams, one bed. Defend it... by lying in it.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o1: Welcome to Farmer Wants a Guh! I am Host Guhvon.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o10: Farmer Guhrrit, it is time. Who do you choose?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o11: ...I can't choose, nyeg. All three snore so beautifully.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o13: And they chonked happily ever after.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o2: Farmer Guhrrit is looking for a guh to chonk with.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o3: Farmer Guhrrit, three letters have arrived for you!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o4: Three! That is almost four, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o5: Letter one: 'Dear farmer, I really love sleeping.'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o6: Letter two: 'I love sleeping too. And nibbles.'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o7: Letter three fell asleep while writing.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o8: The sleepover week! Day one through seven: everybody sleeps.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o9: Shhh... let's tuck them in nice and snug.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.slot: Finish Farmer Wants a Guh in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.uitleg: Farmer Guhrrit is looking for a guh to chonk with. Three letters have arrived!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o1: Gym Leader Naps challenges you to a Guhmon battle!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o10: Guh used Chonk... and falls asleep first!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o11: Guh is asleep! You win the battle!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o12: You slept faster. Here is your gym badge, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o2: Whoever sleeps first wins. Really, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o7: Guh used Eat Nibble! Munch, munch.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o8: Full belly: a little sleepier every turn.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o9: Naps' guh used Nap! That goes fast!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.slot: Win the Guhmon Battle in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.uitleg: A real Guhmon battle! Whoever falls asleep first wins.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o1: Professor Nibbleclone has lost his lab notes.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o10: Eating together. Digesting together. That's real power.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o11: Guhtwo and Mewguh: best friends. The island is saved!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o2: And the clone tank is broken. Bad day, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o3: Six notes and four tank parts later...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o6: It's... GUHTWO! The strongest guh ever cloned. He looks angry.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o7: 'I was made to fight,' says Guhtwo.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o8: His belly says otherwise. His belly says: nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o9: A double helping! And look: Mewguh is here too.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.slot: Become a Friend of Guhtwo: finish the story of Clone Island.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.uitleg: The clone tank is broken and the professor has lost his notes. Who's swimming in that tank?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o1: Welcome to Skyblok. An epic adventure starts here, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o10: The goal in life is chonking. Not a cobblestone generator.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o2: Step 1 of 4,812: build a cobblestone generator.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o3: In the chest: ice. And a bucket of lava you are not allowed to use.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o4: Oops. Oh well. It wasn't allowed anyway, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o5: What a lovely sky. So blue. So... close?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o6: The sky is a painted box. Do not jump into it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o8: ...or a nap. Let's see what the bed does.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o9: SKYBLOK COMPLETED! The only thing that works here is the bed.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.slot: Finish Skyblok in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.uitleg: One little island, 4,812 steps and a bed. Guess which one wins.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o1: A star fell on the hill of Guhwai'i.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o10: And family never leaves you behind, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o11: And taking a nap together is part of that too.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o2: Inside the star was something blue. Something very naughty.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o3: Experiment 626-guh! Made to make a mess.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o4: And he is good at it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o5: Cushions! Coconuts! Nani-guh's laundry! It all goes flying.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o6: Lilo-guh thinks he is sweet anyway. Lilo-guh is right.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o7: A coconut. A hibiscus. Eight cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o8: Not even a naughty experiment can resist that.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.slot: Become an Ohana Guh: finish the story of 626-guh on Guhwai'i.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.uitl: A star fell on Guhwai'i. There was a very naughty little blue guh in it.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o1: 100 guhs jump out of the Chonk Bus. Who stays awake?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o2: Pick your landing spot wisely, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o3: Where do we land? Doesn't matter: soft grass everywhere.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o4: Landed! And... everybody falls asleep at once.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o6: The sleep cloud is closing in. It is pink. And very soft.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o7: Don't fall asleep. Don't fall asleep. Don't...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o8: #1 CHONK ROYALE! You are the only one still awake!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o9: ...and now everybody really is asleep. A tie, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.slot: Finish Chonknite in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.uitle: 100 guhs jump out of the Chonk Bus. Who is the last one awake?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.gids.uitleg: Buy a Guh Cinema Set in the Guhpixel shop, put the projector in front of a screen of Cinema Screen and pick a movie. Your guhs come and sit by themselves!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.melding.geen_doek: Without a Cinema Screen there is nothing to see: put one in front of the lens, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.melding.onbekend: I don't know that movie, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.melding.op_slot: You don't have that movie yet, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.melding.te_ver: You are too far from the projector, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.popcorn.pak: Pop! A tub of popcorn for you.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.popcorn.wacht: The machine is still popping. Finish your own tub first, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.scherm.doek: Screen found: %1$s wide, %2$s high. Go on, pick a movie, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.scherm.geen_doek: The projector sees no Cinema Screen. Put one in front of the lens, within 16 blocks, with its white side toward the projector.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.stoel.bezet: A guh is sitting here already. Let it sit, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.winkel.doek.uitleg: Four extra pieces of screen: for a second screen or to fill a gap.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.winkel.popcornmachi: Every guh in the theater gets a tub of popcorn with the movie. And so do you, if you click it.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.winkel.set.uitleg: Everything for your own cinema: 1 projector, 28 pieces of Cinema Screen (a whole screen of 7 by 4) and 4 Cinema Seats. You earn the movies by playing.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.winkel.stoeltje.uit: An extra seat: for one more guh, or for visitors.
item.guhs.guhbioscoop_popcorn.lore: Still warm. Half of it is gone before the movie starts, nyeg.
